title: AO-Inspired Pipeline Hardening Queue
purpose: Run the safe AO-inspired hardening block from docs/research/composio-agent-orchestrator-applicability.md through the existing AE Agent roadmap supervisor without installing AO, creating branches/worktrees/PRs, touching CEP/live/production/dependencies, or changing package manifests.

sourceContext.executionModel: Sequential roadmap supervisor items, one roadmap-sdk writer child at a time, focused validation per item, handoff after each item, and one reviewable commit per item.
sourceContext.numberingDecision: The research note now shifts this AO-inspired block to M212-M215 because the active plan already contains a duplicate_layers M211 reconciliation. This follows the existing project convention of preserving the requested design while avoiding milestone collisions.

queueItems.title: AO-inspired task/session/activity schema
allowedActions: create .codex-audit/sdk-ao-pattern-intake/212-activity-session-schema.json as a local AO-inspired contract, not an AO integration

define a task envelope with taskId, milestone, source, goal, plannedPaths, forbiddenPaths, allowedCommands, validationCommands, stopGates, escalationRules, nextPrompt, handoffPath, stateFile, activityLog, and reportPath
define session roles writer, reviewer, analyzer, and live-check; define lifecycle states queued, active, idle, needs_input, stuck, errored, done, stopped, and escalated
define activity JSONL event examples for active, ready, idle, needs_input, stuck, errored, done, validation_started, validation_failed, handoff_written, and commit_created
map the contract to the existing roadmap supervisor runtime files under .codex-runtime/sdk/roadmap-supervisor/<session-id>/ without changing runtime behavior
add scripts/sdk-ao-pattern-intake-smoke.js to parse the artifact and assert required fields, states, event examples, roadmap-supervisor mapping, and forbidden-boundary claims
update plans/target-app-execplan.md Progress, Decision Log, Validation, and Active Roadmap notes for this AO-inspired M212 item while recording the existing M211 numbering collision
update .codex/handoff.md with the M212 AO schema state, validation commands, boundaries, commit pending/supervisor commit note, and exact next prompt for M213
forbiddenActions: create a branch, worktree, push, PR, GitHub issue, or GitHub Action
edit CEP panel, bridge runtime, connector, registry, recipe, production, dependency, package manifest, package lock, or live AE/CEP files
claim the schema is active runtime behavior; it is an intake contract only
run live AE/CEP validation or external-provider planner validation

reviewerTasks.prompt: Review the AO-inspired schema intake. Block if it installs AO, enables worktrees/branches/PRs, touches CEP/live/production/dependencies, or presents design-only schema artifacts as active runtime behavior.

queueItems.title: AO-inspired stuck detector and escalation design
allowedActions: create .codex-audit/sdk-ao-pattern-intake/213-stuck-escalation-design.json as a design-only policy over the M212 activity/session contract
define stuck inputs from stale activity, missing log progress, validation failure, child process timeout, needs_input prompt, context_pressure, dirty git state, and unplanned path change
define escalation actions stop_and_handoff, ask_user, create_repair_prompt, retry_later, and fail_closed, with retry caps and no auto-fix default
define examples that turn activity/session events into stuck/escalated outcomes without mutating repository files outside planned paths

add scripts/sdk-ao-stuck-escalation-smoke.js with fixture sessions proving stale activity and validation failures escalate, healthy done sessions do not, and auto-fix/auto-retry/live/dependency actions remain forbidden
update plans/target-app-execplan.md Progress, Decision Log, Validation, and Active Roadmap notes for M213
update .codex/handoff.md with M213 state, validation commands, decisions, risks, and exact next prompt for M214
forbiddenActions: change the roadmap supervisor runner or production runtime behavior
create branches, worktrees, push, PRs, GitHub issues, or GitHub Actions

reviewerTasks.prompt: Review stuck/escalation design. Block if it allows unbounded retry, auto-fix, live/CEP/dependency work, or continuing implementation after context-pressure handoff gates.

queueItems.title: AO-inspired static status dashboard
allowedActions: create .codex-audit/sdk-ao-pattern-intake/214-status-dashboard-contract.json defining a static dashboard over roadmap supervisor state/activity artifacts
add scripts/render-roadmap-supervisor-status-dashboard.js as a no-dependency CLI that reads a supplied session root or fixture root and writes/prints static Markdown only
the dashboard must summarize session id, queue item, role, lifecycle status, last activity, validation result, blockers, changed paths, handoff path, report path, and next action
add scripts/sdk-ao-status-dashboard-smoke.js that builds temp fixture session files, runs the renderer, and asserts active/stuck/done sessions plus next-action text render correctly
ensure the renderer does not start a web server, install packages, write production/runtime files by default, or require live AE/CEP
update plans/target-app-execplan.md Progress, Decision Log, Validation, and Active Roadmap notes for M214
update .codex/handoff.md with M214 state, validation commands, decisions, risks, and exact next prompt for M215
forbiddenActions: add a web server, browser UI, dependency, package script, package manifest change, or package lock change
create branches, worktrees, push, PRs, GitHub issues, or GitHub Actions

reviewerTasks.prompt: Review the status dashboard milestone. Block if it starts a service, adds dependencies, touches CEP/live/production paths, or reads unbounded logs instead of bounded state/activity artifacts.

completion.summary: Added a design-bounded static Markdown status dashboard contract, no-dependency renderer CLI, fixture smoke coverage for active/stuck/done sessions, and active plan notes. Required handoff content is blocked by the current writer-child ACL and must be finalized by supervisor/parent.
boundaryNotes: No web server, browser UI, dependency, package manifest, package lock, AO install/start, CEP/live/production path, branch, worktree, push, PR, GitHub issue, or GitHub Action was added.
The renderer reads only explicit session or fixture roots and writes Markdown only when --output is supplied.
Updating .codex/handoff.md was attempted with apply_patch and PowerShell Set-Content but denied by filesystem ACL.

queueItems.title: AO-inspired read-only failure analyzer packet
allowedActions: create .codex-audit/sdk-ao-pattern-intake/215-readonly-failure-analyzer-contract.json defining a read-only failure packet format

add scripts/create-roadmap-failure-analyzer-packet.js as a no-dependency CLI that reads explicit failure report/log/session fixture paths and emits JSON or Markdown repair packets without changing source files

the packet must include failure class, command, status, relevant log tail, changed paths if supplied, suspected cause with confidence, forbidden auto-actions, repair prompt, and next bounded task fields

add scripts/sdk-ao-failure-analyzer-smoke.js that builds temp fixture failures, runs the analyzer, and asserts validation_failure and stuck_session packets include repair prompts while forbidding auto-fix/live/dependency/PR actions
update the queue artifact closeout notes for this AO-inspired block only if the previous M212-M214 commits are observable in git log
update plans/target-app-execplan.md Progress, Decision Log, Validation, and Active Roadmap notes for M215 and block closeout
update .codex/handoff.md with M215 state, validation commands, decisions, risks, commit pending/supervisor commit note, and exact next prompt for the next thread
forbiddenActions: make the analyzer fix code, edit source based on logs, retry commands, run live AE/CEP, install dependencies, create branches/worktrees, push, PR, GitHub issues, or GitHub Actions
read broad unbounded logs by default; use explicit paths and bounded tails

reviewerTasks.prompt: Review the failure analyzer packet milestone. Block if it can edit code, retry or fix automatically, read broad logs by default, run live/CEP/dependency/package/GitHub actions, or produce an unbounded next task.
